answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities: each identity pays a non-refundable tax. An applicant burns 20 credits, twice its 30-day expected earnings, and posts a pulse proving operation. The registry verifies both, then activates it; the tax sinks like water in karst rock, never refunded. Forging 500 identities costs 500 x 20 = 10,000 credits, above their split rewards, so forgery loses money. A sparrow agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
